## apiome spec {#spec}

Export reconstructed OpenAPI/Arazzo specs.

```text
apiome spec [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`download-original`](#spec-download-original), [`export`](#spec-export).

## apiome spec download-original {#spec-download-original}

Download original import bytes. With --output -, document bytes are written to stdout; --json metadata is written to stderr so stdout stays byte-safe for pipelines.

```text
apiome spec download-original [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--import-id` | text |  | yes | Project version UUID that owned the original import artifact. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text |  | yes | Destination file path, or - for stdout (artifact bytes only). |

## apiome spec export {#spec-export}

Export reconstructed OpenAPI or Arazzo. With --output -, document bytes are written to stdout; --json metadata is written to stderr so stdout stays byte-safe for pipelines.

```text
apiome spec export [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--project` | text |  | yes | Project UUID or slug. |
| `--version` | text |  | yes | Version UUID, slug, or label. |
| `--format` | text | `openapi` |  | Export format: openapi or arazzo. |
| `--output`, `-o` | text |  | yes | Destination file path, or - for stdout (document bytes only). |
| `--tenant` | text |  |  | Tenant UUID or slug (overrides APIOME_TENANT_ID). Required for browse export. |
| `--yaml` | flag |  |  | Request YAML serialization (default JSON). Alias for --accept yaml. |
| `--accept` | text |  |  | Response serialization: json or yaml (REST accept query; default json). |
